name: lever incline prone neutral grip row
description: A chest-supported machine row on an incline with a neutral grip. It builds the mid back without loading the lower back.
instructions: Lie face down on the incline pad with your chest supported.
Grip the neutral handles and extend your arms.
Pull your elbows back past your torso, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Let the handles return slowly until your arms are straight.
